recap.text: Elf hunters out in the forest shell the town with gas-filled rocks from a catapult. Mordecai has made Carl a potion that adds ten intelligence for thirty seconds, then takes ten away for five minutes. Carl drinks it while hovering on Levitation, zooms up through the green cloud, and casts Ping, filtering the map down to purple hunters. He finds two, a kilometre and a half northeast, and hurls Samantha at them.

beats.headline: Three kilometres of Ping
beats.text: Elf hunters with a catapult are shelling the town with gas-filled rocks from somewhere out in the forest. Carl's intelligence sits just over thirty with his daily buffs, and his Ping reaches a kilometre plus five hundred metres for every ten points, so Mordecai has made him a potion: ten more points for thirty seconds, then ten fewer for five minutes. Carl drinks it hovering on Levitation. Boy, are you smart! He zooms up through the green cloud, casts Ping, filters the map down to purple hunters and finds two of them, a kilometre and a half northeast. Then he hurls Samantha at them.
beats.gist: Mordecai's potion lifts Carl's Ping past three kilometres, and he finds two Elf hunters shelling the town.
